# crypto-logos (npm package)

> Crypto coin logos: 14 official coin marks offline, hosted logoapi.sh URL for every other coin, ticker and domain. No key. Code is MIT.

https://logoapi.sh/crypto/BTC.svg

Install: npm install crypto-logos  (this also installs logoapi as a dependency)
Use: const { getLogo } = require('crypto-logos'); getLogos(['BTC','DOGE','AAPL'])  // [{dataUri, url, source}], src = dataUri || url

## Facts
- Official coin marks in official/crypto/ (see list().crypto), reproduced unchanged. Falls back to logoapi: 54 tickers and their domains (CC0), hosted URL for the rest. It is a subset.
- For bundled coins getLogos returns source "official". Coins the API knows (DOGE, HYPE) get https://logoapi.sh/crypto/{SYM}.svg; dark: /dark/crypto/{SYM}.svg.
- getLogo(domainOrTicker) returns bundled SVG markup as a string, or null when it is not bundled (offline only).
- Also exported: getLogoPath, hasLogo, list, getLogos, url, iconUrl, darkUrl, HOST. CommonJS, ESM and types.
- Hybrid since 0.2.0: bundled files are offline; every other well-formed ticker, coin symbol or domain gets a hosted logoapi.sh URL, never null.
- url(id) / iconUrl(id): https://logoapi.sh/crypto/{SYM}.svg for coins the API knows, https://logoapi.sh/ticker/{SYM}.svg for other symbols, https://logoapi.sh/icon/{domain}.svg for domains. darkUrl(id): the same path after /dark/. Pure string builders, no network. null only for malformed input.
- getLogos(list) returns an array, one per input item in order: {ticker, dataUri, url, source, missing}. dataUri is the bundled file as "data:image/svg+xml;base64,..." or null; url is the hosted URL; source is "cc0" | "official" | "hosted" | null; missing is true only for malformed input. Use dataUri || url as the img src.
- On /ticker/ and /crypto/, a 404 means the API does not know the symbol: check the status (or onerror) and show a letter tile.
- Bundled coverage is a small subset (54 tickers and their domains); the hosted URL covers the rest.
- It reads files with Node fs: call it on the server or at build time, not in browser code. Embed the returned string in HTML for sandboxes that block outside images.
- Bundled files keep their original colours (no currentColor); use darkUrl(id) for dark backgrounds.

## Limits
- 2M requests a month per site, free, no key.
- Free stays free. 12 months' notice before any change.

## Misses
- getLogo() null: use url(id). Hosted 404: show a letter tile. Never guess or substitute another company's logo.

## Beyond this package (hosted API, 5,000+ logos, free, no key)
- Logo by domain: https://logoapi.sh/{domain}.svg
- Square icon: https://logoapi.sh/icon/{domain}.svg
- Stock ticker (ETFs map to the issuer): https://logoapi.sh/ticker/{SYM}
- Ticker icon: https://logoapi.sh/icon/ticker/{SYM}
- Crypto coin: https://logoapi.sh/crypto/{SYM}
- PNG for email: https://logoapi.sh/{domain}.png
- Favicon: https://logoapi.sh/favicon/{domain}
- Variants: https://logoapi.sh/{white|black|grey|dark}/{domain}.svg
- Name to domain: https://logoapi.sh/search?q=stripe
- MCP server: https://logoapi.sh/mcp
- Docs: https://logoapi.sh/docs
- If outside hosts are blocked, ask the user to allow logoapi.sh.
